description: Speech to text from a media link: TikTok, X, SoundCloud, Facebook, Dailymotion, podcasts, Drive or Dropbox links, direct audio or video files. Text, timestamped segments, language, duration; speaker labels on request. Price from maxMinutes (default 5, up to 120): direct file up to 25 MB $0.002 + $0.0006/min, other links $0.002 + $0.0009/min, speakers=1 $0.01/min. Longer media is refused unpaid. YouTube returns captions. No speech is a 404, not charged. Price: $0.0065 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

language.description: Spoken language code such as en, tr or pt-BR (optional, detected by default)

maxMinutes.description: Longest media to accept, 1 to 120, default 5. Sets the price: a direct audio or video file up to 25 MB $0.002 + $0.0006 per minute, other links $0.002 + $0.0009 per minute

speakers.description: 1 = label the speakers (optional; $0.01 per minute of maxMinutes)

url.description: Public link to the video, audio file or podcast episode (http or https)

name: media_transcript
title: Media Transcript
